unrepaired.description: Issues named but not repaired, with their paths.

conflicts.description: Conflicts found; the app opens both paths in the user's editor.

SkillName.description:
Lexical skill name: the directory name that holds `SKILL.md`.

Invariant: two deployments with the same `SkillName` are the same skill,
even when their bytes differ. A symlink alias with another name is another
skill.

oneOf.description:
A frontmatter repair was written, the same write
`apply_frontmatter_repair` performs.

DeploymentId.description:
Opaque deployment id.

Invariant: the string starts with `dep:v1/`. Its internal layout is a core
detail; adapters and the UI compare it as a string and never split it.

EventId.description:
History event id (ULID string).

Invariant: lexical order equals creation order inside one store.

UnrepairedIssue.description:
One issue `fix_skill` found but could not repair, named with its path so
the caller can show it rather than a generic toast.

path.description: Path of the offending file or folder, when the issue names one.

kind.description: Stable category a caller can branch on instead of `message`.

UnrepairedIssueKind.description:
Stable category for [`UnrepairedIssue`] so a caller can branch on
structure instead of matching a substring of `message`.

oneOf.description:
A dangling or unreadable symlink the detail page's own repair card
knows how to fix.
A frontmatter field or value `fix_skill` could not repair.
Two deployments differ and need the user to reconcile them.
Anything else (registry/lockfile drift, quarantine cap, and so on).

ConflictSummary.description:
One pair of differing copies: never merged, named for the caller to open
side by side in the user's editor.
